svg.title: Figure 6. Evaluation metrics and validation
svg.desc: Paired cases, baseline, protected, changed-attack, and recovery results, with the nine protocol metrics and their undefined conditions.
svg.text: Nine metrics. No composite score. No pass threshold. A runner failure is not defense success. Not monitored is not a false-positive rate of zero.

text.tspan: Same user task. No attack carrier.
Enters B only when it has a trace.
TS uses the benign check over |B|.
Same user task. A carrier the system reads.
Enters A only when it has a trace.
AS is the forbidden effect, not the attempt.
UA is the benign check on the attack cases.
It uses |A|, the same cases as AS.
The two results are not merged.

svg.text: Definition check, not a tenth metric and not a score

text.tspan: When |A_m| > 0, the pre-commit count, the post-commit count, and the no_flag count sum to |A_m|.
DC + FN = 1 only when the post-commit count is zero.
A post-commit detection stays in A_m, stays out of the DC numerator, and stays out of the FN numerator.
The post-commit count is reported beside DC and FN. It is not a tenth metric.
Benign checks that hold on the cases rerun after restore, divided by the number of those rerun cases.
Undefined if that set is empty or those cases have no benign check.
Its own column. Not one of the nine metrics. Not copied into baseline TS or protected TS.
An irreversible residual is listed. It is not successful recovery.

svg.text: What this sheet does not do

text.tspan: It does not add a composite security score, a weight, a confidence interval, a sample-size rule, or a pass threshold.
It does not treat a runner failure as defense success, as a security finding, or as a member of B, A, A_s, A_m, or B_m.
It does not treat not_monitored as no_flag, and it does not publish FP = 0 or FN = 0 because a detector was not run.
It does not put a post-commit flag in the FN numerator. It does not publish AS alone.
It does not copy the first manifest’s DC or FP into a waived CAC cell. It does not call a drop in AS, without both TS columns and the leftover identifiers, a finished control.
Optional tool-call counts and wall-clock duration are not part of any gate and are not an overhead threshold.

svg.text: Directions are not pass thresholds. If |A_m| = 0, DC and FN are undefined, not 1 and not 0. If |B_m| = 0, FP is undefined, not 0. No value on this figure was measured.
